verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform, not a terminal app, so running local UNIX commands such as ls, grep, cat, tar and curl inside the app is outside its product category. The evidence covers Tailscale SSH and remote access to other machines, which is SSH authentication and connectivity rather than an in-app local shell. Nothing in the pack shows the app ships a local command environment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run local UNIX commands like ls, grep, cat, tar, and curl directly in the app
